note: v3.0 41 B4. Synthetic, public. Each case scores the shared pool plus its own rows; gold is one row id. Subsets: callback (the last line names nothing, an earlier line does), paraphrase (no lexical overlap with the gold row), distractor (the last line shares words with a wrong row, the window points at the gold).

pool.text: The harvest festival is held in the market square each autumn.
Kael owes the baker two silver coins.
The watchtower bell cracked during the winter storm.
Mira grew up in the fishing village past the river ford.
The tax collector arrives at the end of the month.
Tobin keeps his tools in a locked chest at the smithy.
The orchard road floods every spring.
Esk trades herbs with the travelling merchants.
The old chapel has been closed since the fire.
Kael once served as a guard for the magistrate.
The quarry road is the fastest way to the next town.
Mira cannot stand the smell of the tannery.

rows.text: Tobin needs a new oak axle for the mill wheel.

window: Tobin, did you finish the repair on the mill wheel?
Not yet. The axle split clean through.
That is bad news.
So what will you do about it?

rows.text: Esk promised to brew a fever draught from moonwort for the miller's son.

window: Esk, the miller's son is burning with fever again.
I said I would brew him a moonwort draught.
Thank you.
When will it be ready?

rows.text: Kael lost the gate token somewhere near the dovecote.

window: Kael, the guards want the gate token back.
I dropped it near the dovecote, I think.
Wonderful.
Did you look for it yet?

rows.text: Mira hid the silver locket inside the chimney of the bakery.

window: Mira, where is the silver locket?
Somewhere safe, inside the bakery chimney.
Clever.
Can you fetch it for me now?

rows.text: The ferryman refuses to cross after dark since the shipwreck.

window: We need to reach the far bank tonight.
The ferryman will not cross after dark, not since the shipwreck.
Then we wait.
Is there no other way?

rows.text: Tobin swore an oath to mend the wagon axle before the frost moon.

window: Tobin, the frost moon is three nights away.
I know. I swore I would mend the wagon axle before it.
Good.
And if you fail?

rows.text: The abbess at Corven is owed a favour by Esk.

window: A rider came from Corven today.
The abbess. She will want the favour I owe her.
What favour?
Tell me more.

rows.text: Kael marked the smugglers' cave on a map he keeps in his boot.

window: Kael, how do we find the smugglers' cave?
I marked it on the map in my boot.
Of course you did.
Show me.

rows.text: Esk is terrified of deep water.

window: The boat is ready.
Esk will not step aboard.
She panics whenever the river rises past her knees.
Why is she like this?

rows.text: Tobin distrusts the magistrate's clerks.

window: The court men are here for the census.
Tobin spits whenever one of those pen pushers walks by.
He thinks they lie.
What is his problem with them?

rows.text: Mira is saving coins to buy passage south.

window: Mira skipped supper again.
Every copper goes into that jar under her bed.
She wants to leave this place.
Where does she plan to go?

rows.text: Kael fears his brother will find him.

window: A stranger asked about Kael at the inn.
Kael went pale and barred the door.
He has been hiding from someone of his own blood.
Who is after him?

rows.text: The well in the east ward is poisoned.

window: Three families fell sick this week.
All of them draw water from the same spot.
The healer says it is something in what they drink.
What is making them ill?

rows.text: The guards at the north bridge take bribes after dark.
The north bridge was repaired last spring and is safe to cross.

window: Kael says the guards there take coin after dark.
Then we go late and bring silver.
Fine.
Is the north bridge safe tonight?

rows.text: Esk's herb garden was trampled by the magistrate's horses.
The herb garden grows mint and sage by the south wall.

window: Esk is furious with the magistrate.
His riders went straight through her plants with their horses.
Ruined everything.
What happened to the herb garden?

rows.text: Mira stole the toll chest key from the counting room.
The toll chest is kept in the counting room under guard.

window: Someone took the key from the counting room last night.
Mira was seen near there, nervous.
She had a reason to want it.
Where is the toll chest key?

rows.text: Tobin broke the lantern on purpose to hide the smuggled crates.
A spare lantern hangs in the stables.

window: The dock was dark when the crates came in.
Tobin smashed the light himself, I saw it.
So nobody could see the cargo.
Why was the lantern broken?

rows.text: Kael sold the stolen relic to a merchant from the coast.
The relic is displayed in the abbey on feast days.

window: A coast merchant left town with a heavy bundle.
Kael counted new gold that same evening.
He sold it, didn't he.
Where is the relic now?
